418 **R O Y A L C H E M I S T R Y**

<margin>
From the Astral, Venomous, and Spiritual beings, and into the fifth scourge.
</margin>
<margin>
These Sidereal and Firmamental infections are known by the Adept physician and are cured Firmamentally: for Adept medicine is the Art which gives the knowledge of recognizing and expelling Firmamental infections.
</margin>
<margin>
The Magnet of Man. A Magical Cure, in which there is a celestial impression after contact with a herb; as long as the herb is putrefied, it attracts the medicine into the ulcer, and thus heals it.
</margin>

plainly, the greatest part of diseases coming from celestial influence and from the Astral Impression of the Firmament of the Greater World <note>the Macrocosm or universe</note> does not wish to be cured with promiscuous <note>random or unspecific</note> remedies, such as through the <term>Arcana</term> <gloss>secret essences</gloss> of herbs, minerals, or metals; rather, the cure should be instituted through Astronomical Influence with those things at least which have an analogy to the greater and lesser world <note>the Macrocosm and Microcosm/Man</note>. In these things resides the true Magnetic power of the Firmament and the Celestial Impression for resisting diseases from the Firmament of the greater and lesser world, as appears in Water-pepper, Comfrey, Tarragon, and Greater Comfrey.

If a disease or pain is inflicted Supernaturally through incantation or a Magical Impression of Ascendants <note>astrological configurations</note>, then the attempt of the first three modes of healing is useless. Instead, according to Paracelsus, one must proceed Magically and Supernaturally, and the evil must be repelled in the same manner by which it was inflicted. Otherwise, in the aforementioned Simples <note>medicinal herbs</note> there is an Influential attractiveness, and they cure all things by Divine ordination Magically, Astronomically, and Magnetically, because the medicine is in them and the Magnet is in Man. For just as the Sun and Stars have the power of attracting moisture from lower things, so Man (by his implanted magnetic attractive power, like a Magnet drawing the spirit of iron in place of nourishment) and lower things have the same power of attracting from Higher things, as we see in the time of Pestilence; and these chemical

<summary>This page explains that diseases caused by celestial or magical influences require specific cures based on the magnetic correspondence between the Macrocosm and the human Microcosm. It emphasizes that supernatural ailments must be treated with supernatural or astronomical remedies rather than standard herbal or mineral preparations.</summary>

<keywords>Astral Influence, Firmament, Macrocosm, Microcosm, Magnetic Cures, Paracelsus, Magical Medicine, Sympathetic Magic, Pestilence, Water-pepper, Comfrey</keywords>
